headline: Global Fund Managers Restore India Overweight as Tech Allocations Drop, BofA Says
summary: India has re-emerged as a top regional favorite among fund managers after an 11-month hiatus, according to Bank of America's survey, while global technology allocations registered their sharpest monthly drop since 2006.
why: Fund manager sentiment shifts between tech and emerging market equities signal broader global portfolio reallocations away from overextended sectors.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: Fund managers restored overweight positions toward Indian equities in the monthly survey.
